SELECT GROUP_CNAME,GROUP_ENAME, TASK_GROUP_CNAME, TASK_GROUP_ENAME, TASK_GROUP_ORDERNO, TMP_CNAME,TMP_ENAME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME FROM INTERF_TEMPLATE_GROUP itg where 1=1 and flag = #{flag}
AND itg.TMP_CNAME like concat_ws('','%',#{TmpCName},'%')

SELECT TMP_ENAME AS id, TMP_CNAME AS text FROM INTERF_TEMPLATE_GROUP itg where 1=1
AND itg.TmpCName like concat_ws('','%',#{TmpCName},'%')

SELECT ac.seqno ,AC.BUSI_DATE busiDate,AC.END_TIME, (case when IFNULL(LOG.ERROR,0) = 0 then '02' else '09' end) STATUS, (case when IFNULL ( LOG.ERROR, 0 ) = 0 then concat_ws('','执行成功' , LOG.success , '条') else concat_ws('','执行成功' , IFNULL ( LOG.success, 0 ), '条,失败' , IFNULL ( LOG.ERROR, 0 ), '条') end) detailAction ,IFNULL(GR.TASK_GRP_NAME,LOG.FILE_NAME) taskCname,
log.TMP_NAME EName,ac.START_TIME startTime FROM ( SELECT TMP_NAME,FILE_NAME,PARENT_SEQNO, (case when IS_CHECK = 'Y' then COUNT(1) else 0 end) SUCCESS, (case when IS_CHECK = 'N' then COUNT(1) else 0 end) ERROR FROM VAL_INTERFLOG GROUP BY TMP_NAME,FILE_NAME,PARENT_SEQNO,IS_CHECK )LOG left join ( SELECT TASK_GRP_ID, TASK_GRP_NAME FROM bok_BATCH_TASK_GRP GROUP BY TASK_GRP_ID, TASK_GRP_NAME ) GR on GR.TASK_GRP_ID = LOG.TMP_NAME LEFT JOIN VAL_INTERF_ACTIONLOG AC ON AC.SEQNO=LOG.PARENT_SEQNO WHERE AC.SEQNO = #{seqno}
